+class MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE(UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod):
+    """BF16 MoE method for layers a MuseSpark NVFP4 checkpoint excludes.
+
+    Bypasses the oracle, whose TRT-LLM BF16 routing whitelist omits MiniMax2.
+    """
+
+    muse_post_expert_finalize: MusePostExpertFinalize
+
+    def __init__(self, moe: FusedMoEConfig) -> None:
+        self.use_route_major = current_platform.is_device_capability_family(90)
+        if self.use_route_major:
+            _validate_route_major_deployment(moe)
+            FusedMoEMethodBase.__init__(self, moe)
+            self.unquantized_backend = UnquantizedMoeBackend.TRITON
+            self.experts_cls = TritonExperts
+            return
+        super().__init__(moe)
+        modular = uses_modular_all2all(moe)
+        validate_deployment(moe, kernel_routes=not modular)
+        self.unquantized_backend = UnquantizedMoeBackend.FLASHINFER_TRTLLM
+        self.experts_cls = (
+            TrtLlmBf16ExpertsModular if modular else TrtLlmBf16ExpertsMonolithic
+        )
+
+    def _setup_kernel(
+        self,
+        layer: "MuseSparkRoutedExperts",
+        w13: torch.Tensor,
+        w2: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        super()._setup_kernel(layer, w13, w2)
+        _attach_post_expert_finalize(self)
+
+
+class MuseSparkRoutedExperts(MuseSparkConsolidatedRoutedExperts):
+    """Consolidated-tensor experts with the NVFP4 / BF16 quant methods."""
+
+    def _get_quant_method(
+        self,
+        prefix: str,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        moe_config: FusedMoEConfig,
+    ) -> FusedMoEMethodBase:
+        if isinstance(quant_config, ModelOptNvFp4Config) and not (
+            quant_config.is_layer_excluded(prefix)
+        ):
+            return MuseSparkModelOptNvFp4FusedMoE(quant_config, moe_config)
+        # MuseSpark NVFP4 keeps layers 0 and 61 in BF16.
+        return MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE(moe_config)
+
+
+class MuseMoERunner(MoERunner):
+    """MoE runner that splices MuseSpark1x's post-expert norm into the experts."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *args,
+        post_expert_norm: torch.nn.Module,
+        fuse_all_reduce: bool = False,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        routed_experts = self.routed_experts
+        if not isinstance(routed_experts, MuseSparkRoutedExperts):
+            raise TypeError(
+                "MuseMoERunner requires routed_experts_cls=MuseSparkRoutedExperts, "
+                f"got {type(routed_experts).__name__}."
+            )
+        self.post_expert_finalize = MusePostExpertFinalize(
+            post_expert_norm, self.moe_config, fuse_all_reduce
+        )
+        quant_method = cast(
+            MuseSparkModelOptNvFp4FusedMoE | MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE,
+            routed_experts.quant_method,
+        )
+        quant_method.muse_post_expert_finalize = self.post_expert_finalize
+
+    @property
+    def _prepared_nvfp4_experts(self) -> MuseSparkTrtLlmNvFp4Experts | None:
+        quant_method = self.routed_experts.quant_method
+        if not (
+            isinstance(quant_method, MuseSparkModelOptNvFp4FusedMoE)
+            and quant_method.moe_kernel is not None
+        ):
+            return None
+        experts = quant_method.moe_kernel.fused_experts
+        if (
+            not isinstance(experts, MuseSparkTrtLlmNvFp4Experts)
+            or experts.expects_unquantized_inputs
+        ):
+            return None
+        return experts
+
+    @property
+    def nvfp4_input_global_scale(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        """The static NVFP4 input scale, if the experts take prepared inputs."""
+        experts = self._prepared_nvfp4_experts
+        return None if experts is None else experts.quant_config.a1_gscale
+
+    def forward_prepared_nvfp4(
+        self,
+        a1q: torch.Tensor,
+        a1q_scale: torch.Tensor,
+        routing: torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """MoE output from NVFP4 input quantized with ``nvfp4_input_global_scale``.
+
+        ``routing`` is either router logits (the kernel routes) or prepared
+        ``(topk_ids, topk_weights)``.
+        """
+        layer = self.routed_experts
+        experts = self._prepared_nvfp4_experts
+        assert experts is not None
+        if isinstance(routing, tuple):
+            topk_ids, topk_weights = routing
+            output = experts.apply_routed(
+                a1q,
+                a1q_scale,
+                topk_ids,
+                topk_weights,
+                layer.w13_weight,
+                layer.w2_weight,
+                layer.activation,
+                layer.global_num_experts,
+            )
+        else:
+            output = experts.apply(
+                hidden_states=a1q,
+                w1=layer.w13_weight,
+                w2=layer.w2_weight,
+                router_logits=routing,
+                activation=layer.activation,
+                global_num_experts=layer.global_num_experts,
+                expert_map=layer.expert_map,
+                a1q_scale=a1q_scale,
+                apply_router_weight_on_input=layer.apply_router_weight_on_input,
+                e_score_correction_bias=layer.e_score_correction_bias,
+                routed_scaling_factor=layer.routed_scaling_factor,
+            )
+        return self._maybe_reduce_final_output(
+            output, None, self._fused_output_is_reduced
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def _fused_output_is_reduced(self) -> bool:
+        finalize = self.post_expert_finalize
+        return (
+            finalize.pre_norm_all_reduce
+            or finalize.output_reduced
+            or super()._fused_output_is_reduced
+        )

+"""CuTeDSL fused MoE finalize with MuseSpark1x's post-expert RMSNorm."""
+
+import operator
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+try:
+    import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    import cutlass.utils as utils
+    from cutlass import Float32, Int32, Int64
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_ptr
+
+    HAS_CUTEDSL = True
+except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - exercised only without nvidia-cutlass-dsl
+    HAS_CUTEDSL = False
+
+
+_TORCH_TO_CUTLASS_DTYPE = (
+    {
+        torch.float16: cutlass.Float16,
+        torch.bfloat16: cutlass.BFloat16,
+        torch.float32: cutlass.Float32,
+    }
+    if HAS_CUTEDSL
+    else {}
+)
+
+COPY_BITS = 128
+
+
+if HAS_CUTEDSL:
+
+    class _FinalizeConfig:
+        """Launch shape and thread-value layout: one token per CTA."""
+
+        def __init__(self, dtype: Any, hidden_dim: int, threads_per_row=None):
+            self.dtype = dtype
+            self.N = hidden_dim
+            self.vec_size = COPY_BITS // dtype.width
+            self.threads_per_row = (
+                threads_per_row
+                if threads_per_row is not None
+                else self._threads_per_row(hidden_dim, self.vec_size)
+            )
+            self.num_threads = self.threads_per_row
+            self.rows_per_block = 1
+            self.warps_per_row = max(self.threads_per_row // 32, 1)
+
+        @staticmethod
+        def _threads_per_row(N: int, vec_size: int) -> int:
+            if N <= 64:
+                tpr = 8
+            elif N <= 128:
+                tpr = 16
+            elif N <= 2048:
+                tpr = 32
+            elif N <= 2560:
+                tpr = 64
+            elif N <= 16384:
+                tpr = 128
+            else:
+                tpr = 256
+            # The tile has to divide the row exactly: there is no tail path.
+            while tpr > 1 and N % (tpr * vec_size) != 0:
+                tpr //= 2
+            return tpr
+
+        def supported(self) -> bool:
+            return self.N % (self.threads_per_row * self.vec_size) == 0
+
+        def tv_layout(self):
+            vec_size = self.vec_size
+            tpr = self.threads_per_row
+            num_blocks_n = cute.ceil_div(cute.ceil_div(self.N, vec_size), tpr)
+            cols_per_block = self.num_threads // tpr
+            tiler_mn = (cols_per_block, vec_size * num_blocks_n * tpr)
+            tv_layout = cute.make_layout(
+                ((tpr, cols_per_block), (vec_size, num_blocks_n)),
+                stride=(
+                    (vec_size * cols_per_block, 1),
+                    (cols_per_block, cols_per_block * vec_size * tpr),
+                ),
+            )
+            return tiler_mn, tv_layout
+
+        def smem_size_in_bytes(self) -> int:
+            return self.rows_per_block * self.warps_per_row * 4
+
+    class MoEFinalizeRMSNormKernel:
+        """Unpermute + weight-first RMSNorm + fp32 weighted accumulate, per token."""
+
+        def __init__(
+            self,
+            dtype: Any,
+            hidden_dim: int,
+            topk: int,
+            hidden_dim_padded: int,
+            *,
+            weight_before_norm: bool = True,
+            column_major_idx: bool = False,
+            expert_filter: bool = False,
+            threads_per_row=None,
+            enable_pdl: bool = False,
+        ):
+            self.cfg = _FinalizeConfig(dtype, hidden_dim, threads_per_row)
+            self.topk = topk
+            self.hidden_dim_padded = hidden_dim_padded
+            self.weight_before_norm = weight_before_norm
+            self.column_major_idx = column_major_idx
+            self.expert_filter = expert_filter
+            self.enable_pdl = enable_pdl
+
+        @cute.jit
+        def __call__(
+            self,
+            gemm2_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+            expert_weights_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+            idx_map_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+            topk_ids_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+            rms_weight_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+            out_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+            num_tokens: Int32,
+            num_rows: Int32,
+            start_expert: Int32,
+            num_local_experts: Int32,
+            eps: Float32,
+            gain_center: Float32,
+            stream: cuda.CUstream,
+        ):

+            hidden_dim = cfg.N
+            topk = self.topk
+
+            mGemm2 = cute.make_tensor(
+                gemm2_ptr,
+                cute.make_layout(
+                    (num_tokens * topk, hidden_dim),
+                    stride=(self.hidden_dim_padded, 1),
+                ),
+            )
+            mOut = cute.make_tensor(
+                out_ptr,
+                cute.make_layout((num_tokens, hidden_dim), stride=(hidden_dim, 1)),
+            )
+            mW = cute.make_tensor(
+                rms_weight_ptr,
+                cute.make_layout((1, hidden_dim), stride=(hidden_dim, 1)),
+            )
+            flat = cute.make_layout((num_tokens * topk,), stride=(1,))
+            mExpW = cute.make_tensor(expert_weights_ptr, flat)
+            mIdx = cute.make_tensor(idx_map_ptr, flat)
+            mTopkIds = cute.make_tensor(topk_ids_ptr, flat)
+
+            self.kernel(
+                mGemm2,
+                mOut,
+                mW,
+                mExpW,
+                mIdx,
+                mTopkIds,
+                num_tokens,
+                num_rows,
+                start_expert,
+                num_local_experts,
+                eps,
+                gain_center,
+            ).launch(
+                grid=[num_tokens, 1, 1],
+                block=[cfg.num_threads, 1, 1],
+                smem=cfg.smem_size_in_bytes(),
+                stream=stream,
+                use_pdl=self.enable_pdl,
+            )
+
+        @cute.kernel
+        def kernel(
+            self,
+            mGemm2: cute.Tensor,
+            mOut: cute.Tensor,
+            mW: cute.Tensor,
+            mExpW: cute.Tensor,
+            mIdx: cute.Tensor,
+            mTopkIds: cute.Tensor,
+            num_tokens: Int32,
+            num_rows: Int32,
+            start_expert: Int32,
+            num_local_experts: Int32,
+            eps: Float32,
+            gain_center: Float32,
+        ):
+            if cutlass.const_expr(self.enable_pdl):
+                cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+            cfg = self.cfg
+            topk = self.topk
+            hidden_dim = cfg.N
+            threads_per_row = cfg.threads_per_row
+            warps_per_row = cfg.warps_per_row
+
+            tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+            token_idx = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+
+            tiler_mn, tv_layout = cfg.tv_layout()
+
+            smem = utils.SmemAllocator()
+            reduction_buffer = smem.allocate_tensor(
+                Float32, cute.make_layout((1, warps_per_row)), byte_alignment=4
+            )
+
+            copy_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+                cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(),
+                mGemm2.element_type,
+                num_bits_per_copy=COPY_BITS,
+            )
+            thr_copy = cute.make_tiled_copy(copy_atom, tv_layout, tiler_mn).get_slice(
+                tidx
+            )
+
+            tXgW = thr_copy.partition_S(cute.local_tile(mW, tiler_mn, (0, 0)))
+            w_frag = cute.make_fragment_like(tXgW)
+            cute.copy(copy_atom, tXgW, w_frag)
+            w_f32 = w_frag.load().to(cute.Float32) + gain_center
+
+            # Hoisted out of the lane-0 branch: warp_idx() is a full-warp
+            # shuffle and deadlocks if only one lane arrives.
+            lane_idx = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+            warp_col = cute.arch.warp_idx() % warps_per_row
+
+            tXgO = thr_copy.partition_D(cute.local_tile(mOut, tiler_mn, (token_idx, 0)))
+            input_frag = cute.make_fragment_like(tXgW)
+            # fp32 accumulator: rounding each top-k partial would cost accuracy.
+            acc_frag = cute.make_fragment_like(tXgW, Float32)
+            acc_frag.fill(0.0)
+
+            # Non-local slots still run the body: skipping it would put the
+            # cross-warp barriers in a data-dependent branch and hang. Their row
+            # is zeroed on load and discarded after the final barrier.
+            for k in range(topk):
+                expanded_idx = token_idx * topk + k
+                if cutlass.const_expr(self.column_major_idx):
+                    permuted_idx = Int32(mIdx[token_idx + Int32(k) * num_tokens])
+                else:
+                    permuted_idx = Int32(mIdx[expanded_idx])
+
+                is_local = permuted_idx >= 0 and permuted_idx < num_rows
+                if cutlass.const_expr(self.expert_filter):
+                    expert_id = Int32(mTopkIds[expanded_idx])
+                    is_local = (
+                        is_local
+                        and expert_id >= start_expert
+                        and expert_id < start_expert + num_local_experts
+                    )
+
+                row = Int32(0)
+                weight = Float32(0.0)
+                if is_local:
+                    row = permuted_idx
+                    weight = Float32(mExpW[expanded_idx])
+
+                gInput = cute.local_tile(mGemm2, tiler_mn, (Int64(row), 0))
+                # Zero, don't read row 0: the workspace may be unwritten, and
+                # NaN * 0 spreads through the cross-rank reduce. The predicate
+                # is block-uniform, so every thread still reaches the barriers.
+                if is_local:
+                    cute.copy(copy_atom, thr_copy.partition_S(gInput), input_frag)
+                else:
+                    input_frag.fill(0.0)
+
+                scaled = input_frag.load().to(cute.Float32)
+                if cutlass.const_expr(self.weight_before_norm):
+                    scaled = scaled * w_f32
+                sum_sq_local = (scaled * scaled).reduce(
+                    cute.ReductionOp.ADD, init_val=0.0, reduction_profile=0
+                )
+                warp_sum = cute.arch.warp_reduction(
+                    sum_sq_local,
+                    operator.add,
+                    threads_in_group=min(threads_per_row, 32),
+                )
+
+                if cutlass.const_expr(warps_per_row > 1):
+                    # The previous slot's readers are done with the buffer.
+                    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                    if lane_idx == 0:
+                        reduction_buffer[0, warp_col] = warp_sum
+                    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+                    sum_sq = Float32(0.0)
+                    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(warps_per_row):
+                        sum_sq = sum_sq + reduction_buffer[0, w]
+                else:
+                    sum_sq = warp_sum
+
+                inv_rms = cute.math.rsqrt(sum_sq / hidden_dim + eps, fastmath=True)
+                normalized = scaled * inv_rms
+                if cutlass.const_expr(not self.weight_before_norm):
+                    normalized = normalized * w_f32
+                # NaN * 0 is NaN, so a zero weight alone cannot mask a slot.
+                if is_local:
+                    acc_frag.store(acc_frag.load() + normalized * weight)
+
+            out_frag = cute.make_fragment_like(tXgO)
+            out_frag.store(acc_frag.load().to(out_frag.element_type))
+            cute.copy(
+                cute.make_copy_atom(
+                    cute.nvgpu.CopyUniversalOp(),
+                    mOut.element_type,
+                    num_bits_per_copy=COPY_BITS,
+                ),
+                out_frag,
+                tXgO,
+            )
+
+    _compile_cache: dict = {}
+
+    def _compiled_kernel(
+        dtype: Any,
+        hidden_dim: int,
+        topk: int,
+        hidden_dim_padded: int,
+        weight_before_norm: bool,
+        column_major_idx: bool,
+        expert_filter: bool,
+        threads_per_row,
+        stream,
+        w_dtype: Any = None,
+    ):
+        # Weights are read as fp32, so the all2all path's fp32 stays unrounded.
+        w_dtype = w_dtype if w_dtype is not None else dtype
+        enable_pdl = (
+            current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_arch_support_pdl()
+        )
+        key = (
+            enable_pdl,
+            dtype,
+            hidden_dim,
+            topk,
+            hidden_dim_padded,
+            weight_before_norm,
+            column_major_idx,
+            expert_filter,
+            threads_per_row,
+            w_dtype,
+        )
+        compiled = _compile_cache.get(key)
+        if compiled is None:
+            gmem_ptr = lambda t: make_ptr(  # noqa: E731
+                t, 16, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16
+            )
+            compiled = cute.compile(
+                MoEFinalizeRMSNormKernel(
+                    dtype,
+                    hidden_dim,
+                    topk,
+                    hidden_dim_padded,
+                    weight_before_norm=weight_before_norm,
+                    column_major_idx=column_major_idx,
+                    expert_filter=expert_filter,
+                    threads_per_row=threads_per_row,
+                    enable_pdl=enable_pdl,
+                ),
+                gmem_ptr(dtype),
+                gmem_ptr(w_dtype),
+                gmem_ptr(cutlass.Int32),
+                gmem_ptr(cutlass.Int32),
+                gmem_ptr(dtype),
+                gmem_ptr(dtype),
+                Int32(1),
+                Int32(1),
+                Int32(0),
+                Int32(1),
+                Float32(1e-6),
+                Float32(0.0),
+                stream,
+            )
+            _compile_cache[key] = compiled
+        return compiled
+
+
+def moe_finalize_with_rmsnorm(
+    gemm2_output: torch.Tensor,
+    expert_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    permuted_idx: torch.Tensor,
+    rms_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    topk: int,
+    eps: float,
+    gain_center: float = 0.0,
+    weight_before_norm: bool = True,
+    column_major_idx: bool = False,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    start_expert: int = 0,
+    num_local_experts: int = 0,

+    """Unpermute, norm each expert's row, and reduce into ``output``."""
+    assert HAS_CUTEDSL, "the fused MoE finalize requires nvidia-cutlass-dsl"
+    num_tokens, hidden_dim = output.shape

+        return

+    assert expert_weights.dtype in (gemm2_output.dtype, torch.float32), (

+        f"{expert_weights.dtype} vs {gemm2_output.dtype}"
+    )
+    w_dtype = _TORCH_TO_CUTLASS_DTYPE[expert_weights.dtype]

+        column_major_idx,
+        topk_ids is not None,
+        None,
+        stream,
+        w_dtype=w_dtype,
+    )

+        make_ptr(dtype, gemm2_output.data_ptr()),
+        make_ptr(w_dtype, expert_weights.data_ptr()),
+        make_ptr(cutlass.Int32, permuted_idx.data_ptr()),
+        make_ptr(cutlass.Int32, expert_ids.data_ptr()),
+        make_ptr(dtype, rms_norm_weight.data_ptr()),
+        make_ptr(dtype, output.data_ptr()),
+        Int32(num_tokens),
+        Int32(gemm2_output.shape[0]),
+        Int32(start_expert),
+        Int32(num_local_experts),
+        Float32(eps),
+        Float32(gain_center),
+        stream,
+    )
+
+
+def supports_moe_finalize(dtype: torch.dtype, hidden_dim: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether the fused finalize can serve this activation dtype and width."""
+    if not HAS_CUTEDSL or dtype not in _TORCH_TO_CUTLASS_DTYPE:
+        return False
+    return _FinalizeConfig(_TORCH_TO_CUTLASS_DTYPE[dtype], hidden_dim).supported()

+"""CuTeDSL fused QK-norm for MuseSpark1x attention."""
+
+import operator
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+try:
+    import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    import cutlass.utils as utils
+    from cutlass import Float32, Int32
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_ptr
+
+    HAS_CUTEDSL = True
+except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - exercised only without nvidia-cutlass-dsl
+    HAS_CUTEDSL = False
+
+
+_TORCH_TO_CUTLASS_DTYPE = (
+    {
+        torch.float16: cutlass.Float16,
+        torch.bfloat16: cutlass.BFloat16,
+        torch.float32: cutlass.Float32,
+    }
+    if HAS_CUTEDSL
+    else {}
+)
+
+COPY_BITS = 128
+
+
+if HAS_CUTEDSL:
+
+    def _cross_warp_sum(warp_sum, reduction_buffer, warps_per_row, row_idx):
+        """Reduce ``warps_per_row`` warp partials through shared memory."""
+        lane_idx = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+        if lane_idx == 0:
+            reduction_buffer[row_idx, warp_idx % warps_per_row] = warp_sum
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+        block_val = Float32(0.0)
+        if lane_idx < warps_per_row:
+            block_val = reduction_buffer[row_idx, lane_idx]
+        return cute.arch.warp_reduction(block_val, operator.add)
+
+    class _DirectConfig:
+        """Launch shape for the direct-indexing schedule."""
+
+        def __init__(self, dtype: Any, head_dim: int):
+            self.dtype = dtype
+            self.N = head_dim
+            self.vec_size = COPY_BITS // dtype.width
+            self.threads_per_row = self._threads_per_row(head_dim)
+            self.num_threads = 128 if head_dim <= 16384 else 256
+            self.rows_per_block = self.num_threads // self.threads_per_row
+            self.warps_per_row = max(self.threads_per_row // 32, 1)
+
+            # No tail handling: a mismatch silently crosses head boundaries.
+            covered = self.threads_per_row * self.vec_size
+            if covered != head_dim:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"qk_norm cannot handle head_dim={head_dim} at "
+                    f"{dtype.width}-bit: threads_per_row={self.threads_per_row} * "
+                    f"vec_size={self.vec_size} = {covered}, which must equal "
+                    "head_dim."
+                )
+
+        @staticmethod
+        def _threads_per_row(N: int) -> int:
+            if N <= 64:
+                return 8
+            if N <= 128:
+                return 16
+            if N <= 3072:
+                return 32
+            if N <= 6144:
+                return 64
+            if N <= 16384:
+                return 128
+            return 256
+
+        def smem_size_in_bytes(self) -> int:
+            return self.rows_per_block * self.warps_per_row * 4

+    class QKNormDirectKernel:
+        """RMS-norm each ``head_dim`` group, reading a strided input directly.
+
+        Direct indexing avoids a tiled copy's alignment checks on strided input.
+        """

+        def __init__(self, dtype: Any, head_dim: int, has_scale: bool = False):
+            self.cfg = _DirectConfig(dtype, head_dim)
+            self.has_scale = has_scale

+        @cute.jit

+            x_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+            o_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+            M: Int32,
+            num_heads: Int32,
+            input_row_stride: Int32,
+            q_size: Int32,
+            eps: Float32,
+            scale: Float32,
+            stream: cuda.CUstream,

+            mX = cute.make_tensor(
+                x_ptr, cute.make_layout((M, q_size), stride=(input_row_stride, 1))
+            )
+            mO = cute.make_tensor(
+                o_ptr, cute.make_layout((M, q_size), stride=(q_size, 1))
+            )

+                grid=[cute.ceil_div(M, cfg.rows_per_block), num_heads, 1],

+                smem=cfg.smem_size_in_bytes(),
+                stream=stream,
+            )

+        def kernel(
+            self, mX: cute.Tensor, mO: cute.Tensor, eps: Float32, scale: Float32
+        ):
+            cfg = self.cfg
+            tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+            bidx_m = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+            bidx_h = cute.arch.block_idx()[1]
+
+            threads_per_row = cfg.threads_per_row
+            vec_size = cfg.vec_size
+            head_dim = cfg.N
+            warps_per_row = cfg.warps_per_row
+            rows_per_block = cfg.rows_per_block
+            out_dtype = cfg.dtype
+
+            thread_row = tidx // threads_per_row
+            thread_col = tidx % threads_per_row
+            row = bidx_m * rows_per_block + thread_row
+            col_base = bidx_h * head_dim + thread_col * vec_size
+            row_in_bounds = row < mX.shape[0]
+
+            smem = utils.SmemAllocator()
+            reduction_buffer = smem.allocate_tensor(
+                Float32,
+                cute.make_layout((rows_per_block, warps_per_row)),
+                byte_alignment=4,
+            )
+
+            x_reg = cute.make_rmem_tensor(cute.make_layout(vec_size), Float32)
+            local_sum_sq = Float32(0.0)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(vec_size):
+                val = Float32(0.0)
+                if row_in_bounds:
+                    val = Float32(mX[row, col_base + i])
+                x_reg[i] = val
+                local_sum_sq = local_sum_sq + val * val
+
+            warp_sum = cute.arch.warp_reduction(
+                local_sum_sq, operator.add, threads_in_group=min(threads_per_row, 32)
+            )
+            if cutlass.const_expr(warps_per_row > 1):
+                sum_sq = _cross_warp_sum(
+                    warp_sum,
+                    reduction_buffer,
+                    warps_per_row,
+                    cute.arch.warp_idx() // warps_per_row,
+                )
+            else:
+                sum_sq = warp_sum
+
+            rstd = cute.math.rsqrt(sum_sq / head_dim + eps, fastmath=True)
+
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(vec_size):
+                if row_in_bounds:
+                    # fp32 through the scale; the store is the only rounding.
+                    y = x_reg[i] * rstd
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(self.has_scale):
+                        y = y * scale
+                    mO[row, col_base + i] = out_dtype(y)
+
+    _compile_cache: dict = {}
+
+    def _compiled_kernel(dtype: Any, head_dim: int, has_scale: bool, stream):
+        key = (dtype, head_dim, has_scale)
+        compiled = _compile_cache.get(key)
+        if compiled is None:

+                QKNormDirectKernel(dtype, head_dim, has_scale),

+                make_ptr(dtype, 16, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16),

+
+
+def qk_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    head_dim: int,
+    eps: float = 1e-5,
+    scale: float = 1.0,

+    assert HAS_CUTEDSL, "fused QK-norm requires nvidia-cutlass-dsl"
+    assert x.dim() == 2, "x must be [num_tokens, num_heads * head_dim]"
+    assert x.stride(1) == 1, "x must be contiguous along its last dim"

+    assert N % head_dim == 0, f"{N} is not a multiple of head_dim={head_dim}"

+    if M == 0:
+        return out
+
+    dtype = _TORCH_TO_CUTLASS_DTYPE[x.dtype]
+    stream = cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
+    compiled = _compiled_kernel(dtype, head_dim, scale != 1.0, stream)

+        make_ptr(dtype, x.data_ptr(), cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16),
+        make_ptr(dtype, out.data_ptr(), cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=16),
+        Int32(M),
+        Int32(N // head_dim),
+        Int32(x.stride(0)),
+        Int32(N),
+        Float32(eps),
+        Float32(scale),
+        stream,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def supports_qk_norm(dtype: torch.dtype, head_dim: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether the fused kernel (no tail path) can serve this dtype and head."""
+    if not HAS_CUTEDSL or dtype not in _TORCH_TO_CUTLASS_DTYPE:
+        return False
+    try:
+        _DirectConfig(_TORCH_TO_CUTLASS_DTYPE[dtype], head_dim)
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+    return True

+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import in_the_same_node_as
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import LinearBase, UnquantizedLinearMethod
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.common.ops.gemm_rs_ar import GemmRsAr
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+class MuseSparkGemmRs:
+    """One model-owned workspace, shared by sequential attention layers."""
+
+    def __init__(self, kernel: "GemmRsAr") -> None:
+        self.kernel = kernel
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def supports_projection(linear: LinearBase) -> bool:
+        if not isinstance(linear.quant_method, UnquantizedLinearMethod):
+            return False
+        weight = linear.weight
+        return (
+            linear.bias is None
+            and weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and weight.is_cuda
+            and weight.ndim == 2
+            and weight.shape[0] == 8192
+            and weight.shape[1] in (1024, 2048)
+            and weight.is_contiguous()
+        )
+
+    def should_run(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        # B300 TP4/TP8: separate GEMM + Lamport RS wins below M=512 and on
+        # partial tiles (TP4 128 rows, TP8 256; TP8 M=640 also loses). Padded
+        # shards are excluded because the kernel does not initialize them.
+        return (
+            x.ndim == 2
+            and 512 <= x.shape[0] <= self.kernel.max_M
+            and x.shape[0] % (128 if self.kernel.world_size == 4 else 256) == 0
+            and x.shape[1] == 8192 // self.kernel.world_size
+            and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and x.device == self.kernel.device
+            and x.is_contiguous()
+        )
+
+    def __call__(self, x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.kernel(x, weight)
+
+
+def maybe_create_gemm_rs(
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig, projections: list[LinearBase]
+) -> MuseSparkGemmRs | None:
+    """Collectively create a workspace for the measured B300 TP4/TP8 deployments."""
+    pc = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    if (
+        not current_platform.is_cuda()
+        or not current_platform.is_device_capability(103)
+        or pc.tensor_parallel_size not in (4, 8)
+        or pc.pipeline_parallel_size != 1
+        or pc.use_ubatching
+        or vllm_config.lora_config is not None
+        or vllm_config.model_config.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        or vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens < 512
+    ):
+        return None
+    tp_group = get_tp_group()
+    eligible = torch.tensor(
+        int(any(MuseSparkGemmRs.supports_projection(p) for p in projections))
+    )
+    dist.all_reduce(eligible, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=tp_group.cpu_group)
+    if not eligible.item():
+        return None
+    if not all(in_the_same_node_as(tp_group.cpu_group, source_rank=0)):
+        return None
+    physical_id = current_platform.visible_device_id_to_physical_device_id(
+        torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    )
+    physical_ids = [None] * tp_group.world_size
+    dist.all_gather_object(physical_ids, physical_id, group=tp_group.cpu_group)
+    if not current_platform.is_fully_connected(physical_ids):
+        return None
+
+    from vllm.models.common.ops.gemm_rs_ar import (
+        GemmRsAr,
+        Sm100GemmRsArBF16,
+    )
+
+    try:
+        kernel = GemmRsAr(
+            max_M=vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens, N=8192
+        )
+    except RuntimeError as exc:
+        logger.warning_once(
+            "Muse Spark GEMM-RS workspace unavailable; using separate GEMM "
+            "and reduce-scatter: %s",
+            exc,
+        )
+        return None
+    # JIT-compile before CUDA graph capture, bypassing the shared singleton.
+    for bn, cta_group in ((128, 1), (128, 2), (256, 2)):
+        Sm100GemmRsArBF16.compile(kernel.rank, kernel.world_size, bn, cta_group)
+    logger.info_once(
+        "Muse Spark attention GEMM-RS enabled for TP%d BF16, aligned M >= 512.",
+        pc.tensor_parallel_size,
+    )
+    return MuseSparkGemmRs(kernel)

+"""Workspaces for FlashInfer MNNVL collectives fused into Muse Spark boundaries."""

+import functools
+from collections.abc import Callable

+import torch

+@functools.cache
+def tp_group_spans_nodes() -> bool:
+    """Whether the TP group crosses nodes; collective on the first call."""
+    return not all(in_the_same_node_as(get_tp_group().cpu_group, source_rank=0))
+
+
+def _all_tp_ranks(flag: bool) -> bool:
+    value = torch.tensor(int(flag))
+    dist.all_reduce(value, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=get_tp_group().cpu_group)
+    return bool(value.item())
+
+
+def _create_on_all_tp_ranks(name: str, create: Callable[[], Any]) -> Any | None:
+    """Collectively create a workspace; every TP rank gets one or none."""
+    tp_group = get_tp_group()
+    eligible = (
+        current_platform.is_cuda()
+        and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+        and tp_group.world_size > 1
+    )
+    if eligible:
+        try:
+            from flashinfer.comm.mnnvl import is_multicast_supported
+
+            eligible = is_multicast_supported(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+        except ImportError:
+            eligible = False
+    if not _all_tp_ranks(eligible):
+        logger.info_once("Muse Spark fused %s is unavailable.", name)
+        return None
+    try:
+        workspace = create()
+    except (ImportError, RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        logger.warning("Muse Spark fused %s failed: %s", name, exc)
+        workspace = None
+    if not _all_tp_ranks(workspace is not None):
+        return None
+    logger.info_once("Muse Spark fused %s enabled (TP%d).", name, tp_group.world_size)
+    return workspace
+
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Stage BF16 tokens and routing into MegaMoE's symmetric buffer."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _prepare_bf16_kernel(
+    hidden,
+    weights,
+    ids,
+    x_out,
+    ids_out,
+    weights_out,
+    padding,
+    stride_h: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_w: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_i: tl.constexpr,
+    stride_p: tl.constexpr,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0)
+    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    x = tl.load(hidden + token * stride_h + cols, mask=cols < H, other=0)
+    tl.store(x_out + token * H + cols, x, mask=cols < H)
+    routes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    idx = tl.load(ids + token * stride_i + routes, mask=routes < K, other=-1)
+    weight = tl.load(weights + token * stride_w + routes, mask=routes < K, other=0)
+    if padding is not None:
+        padded = tl.load(padding + token * stride_p)
+        idx = tl.where(padded, -1, idx)
+        weight = tl.where(padded, 0.0, weight)
+    tl.store(ids_out + token * K + routes, idx.to(tl.int64), mask=routes < K)
+    tl.store(weights_out + token * K + routes, weight, mask=routes < K)
+
+
+def prepare_megamoe_bf16_inputs(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    x_out: torch.Tensor,
+    ids_out: torch.Tensor,
+    weights_out: torch.Tensor,
+    is_padding: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    tokens, hidden = hidden_states.shape
+    assert hidden_states.dtype == x_out.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert hidden_states.stride(1) == topk_ids.stride(1) == topk_weights.stride(1) == 1
+    assert (
+        x_out.is_contiguous()
+        and ids_out.is_contiguous()
+        and weights_out.is_contiguous()
+    )
+    assert x_out.shape == hidden_states.shape
+    assert topk_ids.shape == topk_weights.shape == ids_out.shape == weights_out.shape
+    assert topk_ids.shape[0] == tokens
+    if tokens == 0:
+        return
+    _prepare_bf16_kernel[(tokens,)](
+        hidden_states,
+        topk_weights,
+        topk_ids,
+        x_out,
+        ids_out,
+        weights_out,
+        is_padding,
+        hidden_states.stride(0),
+        topk_weights.stride(0),
+        topk_ids.stride(0),
+        is_padding.stride(0) if is_padding is not None else 0,
+        hidden,
+        topk_ids.shape[1],
+        triton.next_power_of_2(hidden),
+        triton.next_power_of_2(topk_ids.shape[1]),
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Triton input staging for MuseSpark1x on the NVFP4 MegaMoE kernel.
+
+MegaMoE reads linear scales, not ``scaled_fp4_quant``'s swizzled 128x4 layout.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _quantize_nvfp4(hidden, BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr):
+    num_groups: tl.constexpr = BLOCK_K // 16
+    groups = tl.reshape(hidden, [num_groups, 16])
+    amax = tl.max(tl.abs(groups), axis=1)
+
+    # The divisor is the *quantized* scale, so round-trip it through E4M3. The
+    # floor is E4M3's smallest subnormal, keeping an all-zero block off zero.
+    sf = tl.maximum(amax * (1.0 / 6.0), 2.0**-9).to(tl.float8e4nv)
+    # Compare against scaled grid boundaries rather than dividing: Triton's
+    # division is approximate and rounds exact ties the wrong way. E4M3 scales
+    # (4 significant bits) times boundaries (<= 3) are exact in FP32.
+    sf_f32 = sf.to(tl.float32)[:, None]
+    magnitude = tl.abs(groups)
+
+    # Round to nearest on the E2M1 grid {0, .5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6}. Strict `>`
+    # on one set of midpoints and `>=` on the other sends every tie to an even
+    # code, matching `cvt.rn.satfinite.e2m1x2.f32`.
+    code = (
+        (magnitude > 0.25 * sf_f32).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude > 1.25 * sf_f32).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude > 2.5 * sf_f32).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude > 5.0 * sf_f32).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude >= 0.75 * sf_f32).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude >= 1.75 * sf_f32).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude >= 3.5 * sf_f32).to(tl.uint8)
+    )
+    code |= ((groups < 0) & (code != 0)).to(tl.uint8) << 3
+    code = tl.reshape(code, [BLOCK_K])
+
+    lo, hi = tl.split(tl.reshape(code, [BLOCK_K // 2, 2]))
+    packed = (lo & 0x0F) | (hi << 4)
+    return packed, sf
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _prepare_megamoe_nvfp4_kernel(
+    hidden_states,
+    x_packed,
+    x_sf,
+    topk_ids,
+    topk_weights,
+    is_padding,
+    topk_idx_out,
+    topk_weights_out,
+    hidden_stride_m: tl.constexpr,
+    x_packed_stride_m: tl.constexpr,
+    x_sf_stride_m: tl.constexpr,
+    topk_ids_stride_m: tl.constexpr,
+    topk_weights_stride_m: tl.constexpr,
+    is_padding_stride_m: tl.constexpr,
+    topk_idx_stride_m: tl.constexpr,
+    topk_weights_out_stride_m: tl.constexpr,
+    hidden_size: tl.constexpr,
+    top_k: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_TOPK: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_PDL: tl.constexpr,
+) -> None:
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+
+    token_id = tl.program_id(0)
+    k_block_id = tl.program_id(1)
+
+    k_offsets = k_block_id * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    hidden = tl.load(hidden_states + token_id * hidden_stride_m + k_offsets).to(
+        tl.float32
+    )
+
+    num_groups: tl.constexpr = BLOCK_K // 16
+    packed, sf = _quantize_nvfp4(hidden, BLOCK_K)
+    tl.store(
+        x_packed
+        + token_id * x_packed_stride_m
+        + k_block_id * (BLOCK_K // 2)
+        + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 2),
+        packed,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        x_sf
+        + token_id * x_sf_stride_m
+        + k_block_id * num_groups
+        + tl.arange(0, num_groups),
+        sf.to(tl.uint8, bitcast=True),
+    )
+
+    if k_block_id == 0:
+        topk_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_TOPK)
+        topk_mask = topk_offsets < top_k
+        token_is_padding = False
+        if is_padding is not None:
+            token_is_padding = tl.load(is_padding + token_id * is_padding_stride_m)
+
+        ids = tl.load(
+            topk_ids + token_id * topk_ids_stride_m + topk_offsets,
+            mask=topk_mask,
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+        tl.store(
+            topk_idx_out + token_id * topk_idx_stride_m + topk_offsets,
+            tl.where(token_is_padding, -1, ids),
+            mask=topk_mask,
+        )
+
+        weights = tl.load(
+            topk_weights + token_id * topk_weights_stride_m + topk_offsets,
+            mask=topk_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        tl.store(
+            topk_weights_out + token_id * topk_weights_out_stride_m + topk_offsets,
+            tl.where(token_is_padding, 0.0, weights),
+            mask=topk_mask,
+        )
+
+
+def prepare_megamoe_nvfp4_inputs(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    x_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    x_sf: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_idx_out: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_weights_out: torch.Tensor,
+    is_padding: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Stage ``hidden_states`` and routing into MegaMoE's symmetric buffer."""
+    num_tokens, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return
+    if hidden_size % 64 != 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MuseSpark1x NVFP4 MegaMoE staging requires hidden_size to be a "
+            f"multiple of 64, got {hidden_size}."
+        )
+    if topk_weights.shape != topk_ids.shape:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "MuseSpark1x NVFP4 MegaMoE staging requires topk_weights and "
+            "topk_ids to have the same shape."
+        )
+
+    top_k = topk_ids.shape[1]
+    num_elements = num_tokens * hidden_size
+    if num_elements <= 512 * 1024:
+        block_k, num_warps = 256, 4
+    elif num_elements < 2 * 1024 * 1024:
+        block_k, num_warps = 512, 2
+    else:
+        block_k, num_warps = 1024, 1
+    block_k = min(block_k, hidden_size)
+    while hidden_size % block_k != 0:
+        block_k //= 2
+
+    enable_pdl = current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_arch_support_pdl()
+    _prepare_megamoe_nvfp4_kernel[(num_tokens, hidden_size // block_k)](
+        hidden_states,
+        x_packed,
+        x_sf,
+        topk_ids,
+        topk_weights,
+        is_padding,
+        topk_idx_out,
+        topk_weights_out,
+        hidden_states.stride(0),
+        x_packed.stride(0),
+        x_sf.stride(0),
+        topk_ids.stride(0),
+        topk_weights.stride(0),
+        is_padding.stride(0) if is_padding is not None else 0,
+        topk_idx_out.stride(0),
+        topk_weights_out.stride(0),
+        hidden_size=hidden_size,
+        top_k=top_k,
+        BLOCK_K=block_k,
+        BLOCK_TOPK=triton.next_power_of_2(top_k),
+        USE_PDL=enable_pdl,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+        **({"launch_pdl": True} if enable_pdl else {}),
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _norm_quant_megamoe_nvfp4_kernel(
+    x,
+    weight,
+    packed_out,
+    sf_out,
+    x_stride: tl.constexpr,
+    packed_stride: tl.constexpr,
+    sf_stride: tl.constexpr,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    HIDDEN: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_PDL: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+
+    token = tl.program_id(0)
+    block = tl.program_id(1)
+    d = tl.arange(0, HIDDEN)
+    row = tl.load(x + token * x_stride + d).to(tl.float32)
+    rstd = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(row * row, axis=0) * (1.0 / HIDDEN) + eps)
+    k = block * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    hidden = tl.load(x + token * x_stride + k).to(tl.float32)
+    gamma = tl.load(weight + k).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+    # Round to BF16 as the unfused norm -> quantize path does.
+    hidden = ((hidden * rstd) * gamma).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    packed, sf = _quantize_nvfp4(hidden, BLOCK_K)
+    tl.store(
+        packed_out
+        + token * packed_stride
+        + block * (BLOCK_K // 2)
+        + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 2),
+        packed,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        sf_out
+        + token * sf_stride
+        + block * (BLOCK_K // 16)
+        + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 16),
+        sf.to(tl.uint8, bitcast=True),
+    )
+
+
+def prepare_megamoe_nvfp4_with_norm(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_eps: float,
+    gain_center: float,
+    x_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    x_sf: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """Normalize BF16 pooled states and write NVFP4 into MegaMoE's buffer.
+
+    The caller must join the routing aux stream before launching MegaMoE.
+    """
+    num_tokens, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
+    assert hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and hidden_states.is_contiguous()
+    assert hidden_size == 4096
+    assert norm_weight.shape == (hidden_size,) and norm_weight.is_contiguous()
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return
+    enable_pdl = current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_arch_support_pdl()
+    _norm_quant_megamoe_nvfp4_kernel[(num_tokens, hidden_size // 1024)](
+        hidden_states,
+        norm_weight,
+        x_packed,
+        x_sf,
+        hidden_states.stride(0),
+        x_packed.stride(0),
+        x_sf.stride(0),
+        norm_eps,
+        gain_center,
+        hidden_size,
+        1024,
+        num_warps=8,
+        enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        USE_PDL=enable_pdl,
+        **({"launch_pdl": True} if enable_pdl else {}),
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Pre-expert RMSNorm fused with the TRT-LLM MoE's NVFP4 input quantization.
+
+Matches ``MuseSpark1xRMSNorm`` (one BF16 rounding) followed by
+``scaled_fp4_quant(..., is_sf_swizzled_layout=False)`` with the static global
+scale, and reads the pooler output either contiguous or in the rank-block
+layout ``[tp, M, H / tp]`` left by a column all-gather.
+"""
+
+import functools
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+_BLOCK_K = 1024
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _enable_pdl() -> bool:
+    return current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_arch_support_pdl()
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rcp_approx(x):
+    return tl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+        "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 $0, $1;",
+        "=f,f",
+        [x],
+        dtype=tl.float32,
+        is_pure=True,
+        pack=1,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _quantize_nvfp4_global_scale(values, global_scale, BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr):
+    """``scaled_fp4_quant``'s arithmetic (nvfp4_utils.cuh), linear scales."""
+    groups = tl.reshape(values, [BLOCK_K // 16, 16])
+    amax = tl.max(tl.abs(groups), axis=1)
+    sf = (global_scale * (amax * _rcp_approx(6.0))).to(tl.float8e4nv)
+    sf_f32 = sf.to(tl.float32)
+    out_scale = tl.where(
+        sf_f32 != 0.0, _rcp_approx(sf_f32 * _rcp_approx(global_scale)), 0.0
+    )
+    scaled = groups * out_scale[:, None]
+    magnitude = tl.abs(scaled)
+    # Round to nearest even on the E2M1 grid {0, .5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6},
+    # saturating, as cvt.rn.satfinite.e2m1x2.f32 does.
+    code = (
+        (magnitude > 0.25).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude >= 0.75).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude > 1.25).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude >= 1.75).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude > 2.5).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude >= 3.5).to(tl.uint8)
+        + (magnitude > 5.0).to(tl.uint8)
+    )
+    code |= (scaled < 0).to(tl.uint8) << 3
+    lo, hi = tl.split(tl.reshape(code, [BLOCK_K // 2, 2]))
+    return (lo & 0x0F) | (hi << 4), sf
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _norm_quant_trtllm_nvfp4_kernel(
+    x,
+    weight,
+    global_scale,
+    packed_out,
+    sf_out,
+    num_tokens,
+    eps,
+    gain_center,
+    HIDDEN: tl.constexpr,
+    SHARD: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    USE_PDL: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    if USE_PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+
+    token = tl.program_id(0)
+    block = tl.program_id(1)
+    # Column d of the token lives in shard d // SHARD of the rank-block layout.
+    d = tl.arange(0, HIDDEN)
+    row = tl.load(x + ((d // SHARD) * num_tokens + token) * SHARD + d % SHARD)
+    row = row.to(tl.float32)
+    rstd = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(row * row, axis=0) * (1.0 / HIDDEN) + eps)
+    k = block * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    values = tl.load(x + ((k // SHARD) * num_tokens + token) * SHARD + k % SHARD)
+    gamma = tl.load(weight + k).to(tl.float32) + gain_center
+    # Round to BF16 as the unfused norm -> quantize path does.
+    values = ((values.to(tl.float32) * rstd) * gamma).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    packed, sf = _quantize_nvfp4_global_scale(values, tl.load(global_scale), BLOCK_K)
+    tl.store(
+        packed_out
+        + token * (HIDDEN // 2)
+        + block * (BLOCK_K // 2)
+        + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 2),
+        packed,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        sf_out
+        + token * (HIDDEN // 16)
+        + block * (BLOCK_K // 16)
+        + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 16),
+        sf.to(tl.uint8, bitcast=True),
+    )
+
+
+def norm_quant_trtllm_nvfp4(
+    pooled: torch.Tensor,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_eps: float,
+    gain_center: float,
+    global_scale: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """RMSNorm + NVFP4 quant of ``[M, H]`` pooled states, in any rank-block layout.
+
+    ``pooled`` is ``[M, H]`` or the ``[tp * M, H / tp]`` output of a dim-0
+    all-gather of column shards. Returns packed ``[M, H/2]`` uint8 values and
+    linear ``[M, H/16]`` uint8 (E4M3) block scales.
+    """
+    hidden = norm_weight.shape[0]
+    shard = pooled.shape[1]
+    assert pooled.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and pooled.is_contiguous()
+    assert pooled.shape[0] * shard == num_tokens * hidden and hidden % _BLOCK_K == 0
+    packed = torch.empty(
+        num_tokens, hidden // 2, dtype=torch.uint8, device=pooled.device
+    )
+    sf = torch.empty(num_tokens, hidden // 16, dtype=torch.uint8, device=pooled.device)
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return packed, sf
+    enable_pdl = _enable_pdl()
+    _norm_quant_trtllm_nvfp4_kernel[(num_tokens, hidden // _BLOCK_K)](
+        pooled,
+        norm_weight,
+        global_scale,
+        packed,
+        sf,
+        num_tokens,
+        norm_eps,
+        gain_center,
+        HIDDEN=hidden,
+        SHARD=shard,
+        BLOCK_K=_BLOCK_K,
+        USE_PDL=enable_pdl,
+        num_warps=8,
+        enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        **({"launch_pdl": True} if enable_pdl else {}),
+    )
+    return packed, sf

skip_special_tokens now defaults to None in the chat, completion and responses requests, but only to_sampling_params resolves it. That breaks three things for every model. (1) /v1/completions with use_beam_search=true and no skip_special_tokens passes None through to_beam_search_params (:344), and tokenizer.decode(..., skip_special_tokens=None) in beam_search/online.py:232 raises TypeError on HF fast tokenizers. The beam case in test_completion.py:620 takes this path. (2) online_derenderer.py:1046 reads the raw field, so derender keeps special tokens that the coupled endpoint strips. (3) 18 existing CPU tests that expect a default request to have True now fail.

Keep bool = True and using the generation-config value only when the client did not send the field: self.skip_special_tokens if "skip_special_tokens" in self.model_fields_set else default_sampling_params.get("skip_special_tokens", True)

inline_comments.body:
This changes the standalone FlashInfer MNNVL all-reduce for every model, not just Muse.
- B200/GB200 TP8 had no entry, so it fell back to the 1 MiB fusion limit. With default settings, every TP all-reduce up to 128 MiB per rank now goes to FlashInfer MNNVL instead of NCCL symm-mem or custom AR.
- On B300 TP8 this doubles the 64 MiB cutoff tuned in #53606.
- flashinfer_all_reduce.py:69 drops the -1, so every cutoff becomes inclusive.
get_fi_ar_workspace sizes the workspace from this value with no max_num_batched_tokens cap, and the test now expects 9362 tokens instead of 4681. By my reading of the flashinfer 0.7.2 sizing, that is roughly 0.75 GiB per GPU taken from the KV cache. Could you split this out with B200/B300 TP8 all-reduce sweeps and memory numbers, or gate it to Muse?

The Quark expert audit (_expected_quark_expert_weight_slots :746) expects w13 and w2 weight slots for every global expert. With --enable-expert-parallel --enable-ep-weight-filter, the loader skips the .weight tensors of non-local experts (ep_weight_filter.py:84). In that case a Muse Quark FP8 or MXFP4 checkpoint at TP8+EP on MI355X raises "Missing MuseSpark1x Quark expert tensors" on every rank and never starts (same at :631 for MXFP4).

+        expert_map = (
+            self.take_route_expert_map()
+            if self.take_route_expert_map is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        num_tokens, top_k = topk_ids.shape
+        hidden_dim = fused_expert_output.shape[-1]
+        routed = fused_expert_output.view(num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim)
+
+        if output is None:
+            output = torch.empty(
+                (num_tokens, hidden_dim),
+                dtype=routed.dtype,
+                device=routed.device,
+            )
+        if output.shape != (num_tokens, hidden_dim):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MuseSpark1x MoE output has shape "
+                f"{tuple(output.shape)}, expected {(num_tokens, hidden_dim)}."
+            )
+        if expert_map is not None and (
+            self.pre_norm_all_reduce or self.fused_norm is None
+        ):
+            # Only the fused finalize masks unwritten non-local routes itself.
+            routed.masked_fill_((expert_map[topk_ids.long()] < 0).unsqueeze(-1), 0)
+            expert_map = None
+
+        chunk_size = self._chunk_size(top_k, hidden_dim)
+        for start in range(0, num_tokens, chunk_size):
+            end = min(start + chunk_size, num_tokens)
+            rows = routed[start:end]
+            if (
+                self.pre_norm_all_reduce
+                and self.fused_norm is not None
+                and rows.shape[0] >= self.rs_min_tokens
+                and (tp_size := get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()) > 1
+            ):
+                self._token_sharded_finalize(
+                    rows.to(self.reduce_dtype),
+                    topk_weights[start:end],
+                    output[start:end],
+                    tp_size,
+                )
+                continue
+            if self.pre_norm_all_reduce:
+                rows = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(rows.to(self.reduce_dtype))
+
+            if self.fused_norm is not None:
+                fused_post_expert_finalize(
+                    rows,
+                    self.fused_norm.weight if self.fused_norm.has_weight else None,
+                    topk_weights[start:end],
+                    self.fused_norm.variance_epsilon,
+                    self.fused_norm.fused_gain_center,
+                    self.fused_norm.applies_weight_before_norm,
+                    output[start:end],
+                    topk_ids=None if expert_map is None else topk_ids[start:end],
+                    expert_map=expert_map,
+                )
+                continue
+            normalized = self.post_expert_norm_fn(rows, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+            normalized.mul_(topk_weights[start:end].float().unsqueeze(-1))
+            output[start:end].copy_(normalized.sum(dim=1).to(output.dtype))
+
+        return output
+
+    def _token_sharded_finalize(
+        self,
+        rows: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        out: torch.Tensor,
+        tp_size: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim = rows.shape
+        pad = (-num_tokens) % tp_size
+        if pad:
+            rows = torch.cat([rows, rows.new_zeros((pad, top_k, hidden_dim))])
+            topk_weights = torch.cat(
+                [topk_weights, topk_weights.new_zeros((pad, top_k))]
+            )
+        local = tensor_model_parallel_reduce_scatter(rows, dim=0)
+        per_rank = local.shape[0]
+        rank = get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
+        tw_local = topk_weights[rank * per_rank : (rank + 1) * per_rank]
+        out_local = torch.empty(
+            (per_rank, hidden_dim), dtype=out.dtype, device=out.device
+        )
+        norm = self.fused_norm
+        assert norm is not None
+        fused_post_expert_finalize(
+            local,
+            norm.weight if norm.has_weight else None,
+            tw_local,
+            norm.variance_epsilon,
+            norm.fused_gain_center,
+            norm.applies_weight_before_norm,
+            out_local,
+        )
+        gathered = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(out_local, dim=0)
+        out.copy_(gathered[:num_tokens])
+
+
+class _RouteOutputHandoff:
+    """Hand the experts' per-route buffer to the finalize instead of copying it."""
+
+    _route_output: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    _route_expert_map: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    def _park_route_output(
+        self, route_output: torch.Tensor, expert_map: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    ) -> None:
+        self._route_output = route_output
+        self._route_expert_map = expert_map
+
+    def _take_route_output(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        route_output, self._route_output = self._route_output, None
+        return route_output
+
+    def _take_route_expert_map(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        expert_map, self._route_expert_map = self._route_expert_map, None
+        return expert_map
+
+
+class MuseSparkTritonExperts(_RouteOutputHandoff, TritonExperts):
+    """Triton experts that expose unweighted GEMM2 output per route."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        moe_config: FusedMoEConfig,
+        quant_config: FusedMoEQuantConfig,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(moe_config, quant_config)
+        if not isinstance(
+            quant_config,
+            (MuseSparkUnquantizedMoEQuantConfig, MuseSparkQuarkFp8MoEQuantConfig),
+        ):
+            raise TypeError(
+                "MuseSparkTritonExperts requires a MuseSpark Triton quant config."
+            )
+        if quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn is None:
+            raise ValueError("MuseSpark1x post-expert norm is not configured.")
+
+    def workspace_shapes(
+        self,
+        M: int,
+        N: int,
+        K: int,
+        topk: int,
+        global_num_experts: int,
+        local_num_experts: int,
+        expert_tokens_meta: mk.ExpertTokensMetadata | None,
+        activation: MoEActivation,
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...]]:
+        workspace13, workspace2, _ = super().workspace_shapes(
+            M,
+            N,
+            K,
+            topk,
+            global_num_experts,
+            local_num_experts,
+            expert_tokens_meta,
+            activation,
+        )
+        return workspace13, workspace2, (M, topk, K)
+
+    def _apply_router_weight_in_gemm2(self, apply_router_weight_on_input: bool) -> bool:
+        if apply_router_weight_on_input:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x requires router weights after the post-expert norm."
+            )
+        return False
+
+    def _finalize_expert_output(
+        self,
+        expert_output: torch.Tensor,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        expert_map: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        # Under EP the GEMM skips non-local routes, leaving their rows unwritten.
+        self._park_route_output(expert_output, expert_map)
+
+    def finalize_weight_and_reduce_impl(self) -> mk.TopKWeightAndReduce:
+        quant_config = self.quant_config
+        assert isinstance(
+            quant_config,
+            (MuseSparkUnquantizedMoEQuantConfig, MuseSparkQuarkFp8MoEQuantConfig),
+        )
+        assert quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn is not None
+        return MuseSparkTopKWeightAndReduce(
+            quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn,
+            pre_norm_all_reduce=self.moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_size > 1,
+            take_route_output=self._take_route_output,
+            take_route_expert_map=self._take_route_expert_map,
+        )
+
+
+class MuseSparkUnquantizedFusedMoE(UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod):
+    """BF16 MoE method pinned to the MuseSpark-aware Triton experts."""
+
+    def __init__(self, moe: FusedMoEConfig) -> None:
+        validate_bf16_deployment(moe)
+        # Triton-only: skip the generic constructor's backend oracle.
+        FusedMoEMethodBase.__init__(self, moe)
+        self.unquantized_backend = UnquantizedMoeBackend.TRITON
+        self.experts_cls = MuseSparkTritonExperts
+
+    def get_fused_moe_quant_config(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> FusedMoEQuantConfig:
+        base_config = super().get_fused_moe_quant_config(layer)
+        post_expert_norm_fn = getattr(layer, "post_expert_norm_fn", None)
+        if post_expert_norm_fn is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("MuseSpark1x post-expert norm is not configured.")
+        return MuseSparkUnquantizedMoEQuantConfig(
+            **vars(base_config),
+            post_expert_norm_fn=post_expert_norm_fn,
+        )
+
+
+class MuseSparkAiterExperts(_RouteOutputHandoff, AiterMxfp4Experts):
+    """AITER experts that return one unweighted output per selected route."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        moe_config: FusedMoEConfig,
+        quant_config: FusedMoEQuantConfig,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(moe_config, quant_config)
+        if not isinstance(quant_config, MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig):
+            raise TypeError(
+                "MuseSparkAiterExperts requires MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig."
+            )
+        if quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn is None:
+            raise ValueError("MuseSpark1x post-expert norm is not configured.")
+        self._unit_weights_bufs: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}
+
+    def _unit_weights(
+        self, num_routes: int, width: int, device: torch.device
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """A cached ``[num_routes, width]`` fp32 ones buffer (grown on demand)."""
+        buf = self._unit_weights_bufs.get(width)
+        if buf is None or buf.shape[0] < num_routes or buf.device != device:
+            buf = torch.ones(
+                (max(num_routes, 1), width), dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+            )
+            self._unit_weights_bufs[width] = buf
+        return buf[:num_routes]
+
+    def workspace_shapes(
+        self,
+        M: int,
+        N: int,
+        K: int,
+        topk: int,
+        global_num_experts: int,
+        local_num_experts: int,
+        expert_tokens_meta: mk.ExpertTokensMetadata | None,
+        activation: MoEActivation,
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...]]:
+        workspace13, workspace2, _ = super().workspace_shapes(
+            M,
+            N,
+            K,
+            topk,
+            global_num_experts,
+            local_num_experts,
+            expert_tokens_meta,
+            activation,
+        )
+        return workspace13, workspace2, (M, topk, K)
+
+    def apply(
+        self,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        w1: torch.Tensor,
+        w2: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        activation: MoEActivation,
+        global_num_experts: int,
+        expert_map: torch.Tensor | None,
+        a1q_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        a2_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        workspace13: torch.Tensor,
+        workspace2: torch.Tensor,
+        expert_tokens_meta: mk.ExpertTokensMetadata | None,
+        apply_router_weight_on_input: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        if apply_router_weight_on_input:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x requires router weights after the post-expert norm."
+            )
+
+        num_tokens, top_k = topk_ids.shape
+        hidden_dim = hidden_states.shape[-1]
+        expected_output_shape = (num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim)
+        if output.shape != expected_output_shape:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "MuseSpark1x AITER output has shape "
+                f"{tuple(output.shape)}, expected {expected_output_shape}."
+            )
+
+        expanded_hidden_states = take_expanded(hidden_states, top_k)
+        if expanded_hidden_states is None:
+            expanded_hidden_states = (
+                hidden_states[:, None, :]
+                .expand(num_tokens, top_k, hidden_dim)
+                .reshape(num_tokens * top_k, hidden_dim)
+                .contiguous()
+            )
+        # Only the shape of topk_ids is read after the experts.
+        num_routes = num_tokens * top_k
+        flat_topk_ids = topk_ids.view(num_routes, 1)
+        if expert_map is not None:
+            # AITER's EP convention: one extra route per row on the always-masked
+            # last expert_mask slot; its tuned-config lookup subtracts it.
+            masked_slot = flat_topk_ids.new_full(
+                (num_routes, 1), expert_map.shape[0] - 1
+            )
+            flat_topk_ids = torch.cat((flat_topk_ids, masked_slot), dim=1)
+        unit_topk_weights = self._unit_weights(
+            num_routes, flat_topk_ids.shape[1], topk_ids.device
+        )
+
+        if expert_tokens_meta is not None:
+            num_local_tokens = expert_tokens_meta.expert_num_tokens
+        else:
+            num_local_tokens = None
+
+        route_output = rocm_aiter_fused_experts(
+            hidden_states=expanded_hidden_states,
+            w1=w1,
+            w2=w2,
+            topk_weights=unit_topk_weights,
+            topk_ids=flat_topk_ids,
+            activation=activation,
+            expert_mask=expert_map,
+            quant_config=self.quant_config,
+            moe_config=self.moe_config,
+            a1q_scale=a1q_scale,
+            num_local_tokens=num_local_tokens,
+            output_dtype=output.dtype,
+            moe_sorting_dispatch_policy=rocm_aiter_ops.get_moe_dispatch_policy(),
+            apply_router_weight_on_input=False,
+        )
+        self._park_route_output(route_output.view_as(output))
+
+    def finalize_weight_and_reduce_impl(self) -> mk.TopKWeightAndReduce:
+        quant_config = self.quant_config
+        assert isinstance(quant_config, MuseSparkQuarkOCPMXMoEQuantConfig)
+        assert quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn is not None
+        return MuseSparkTopKWeightAndReduce(
+            quant_config.post_expert_norm_fn,
+            pre_norm_all_reduce=self.moe_config.moe_parallel_config.tp_size > 1,
+            take_route_output=self._take_route_output,
+        )
+
+
+class MuseSparkQuarkW8A8Fp8FusedMoE(QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod):
+    """Quark W8A8 FP8 method using route-preserving Triton experts."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        moe: FusedMoEConfig,
+        weight_quant_key: QuantKey,
+        activation_quant_key: QuantKey | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        validate_fp8_deployment(moe)
+        super().__init__(moe, weight_quant_key, activation_quant_key)
+        if self.fp8_backend is not Fp8MoeBackend.TRITON:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "MuseSpark1x FP8 on ROCm requires the Triton FP8 MoE backend; "
+                f"got {self.fp8_backend.value}."
+            )
+        self.experts_cls = MuseSparkTritonExperts
+
+    def get_fused_moe_quant_config(
+        self, layer: RoutedExperts

+        base_config = super().get_fused_moe_quant_config(layer)

+            raise RuntimeError("MuseSpark1x post-expert norm is not configured.")
+        return MuseSparkQuarkFp8MoEQuantConfig(

inline_comments.body: chrono's format(...).to_string() panics on an invalid specifier, for example strftime_now('%Q') or a trailing %. rust/Cargo.toml sets panic = "abort", so the panic kills the frontend process. With VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1, the per-request chat_template is passed through with no trust check (convert.rs:193), so a single request can take the server down for any model.
